parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is experimental, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How experimental APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/experimental/overview) for details.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of agents to return. Defaults to 50. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Send the same filters that the previous request used.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filters that choose which agents are returned. The supported fields are name and description, with the operator EQUALS. Multiple values OR within a filter. Multiple filters AND together, and each field can appear in only one filter. For example, to return agents whose name contains "HR", send [{"field":"name","values":["HR"]}].

schema.description: Filters on agent fields, combined with AND.

items.description: One filter on an agent field.

field.description: The agent field to filter on. name matches agents whose name contains the value. description matches agents whose description contains the value. Matching ignores case and surrounding whitespace. Each value is at most 256 characters.

values.description: The values to match. An agent matches when any value matches.

items.description: A value to match. Blank values are rejected.

operator.description: The only supported operator is EQUALS. Defaults to EQUALS.

items.title: PlatformAdminAgentFilter
